description: Ken introduces himself as recording an interview at UCF’s John C. Hitt Library for the Knights Tales Project on September 11, 2026, the 25th anniversary of 9/11. He recalls working for Steelcase, whose headquarters was in Grand Rapids, Michigan, while his territory was New York City. Before the attacks, he and his wife had traveled to the New York City area over Labor Day 2001 to seek employment and housing; he says his first visit to the World Trade Center towers was during that trip. He describes being at Steelcase headquarters in Grand Rapids on September 11, 2001, watching events unfold there, and being unable to reach his wife, who was working for Social Security. He says he later met his wife at home in Grand Rapids and recalls meeting a friend in the World Trade Center shopping area during his earlier visit. He reflects on the people who worked in the World Trade Center, remembers the victims, and expresses hope and prayer for healing. In the supplied video frames, the speaker wears a dark collared top and pale-framed glasses; frames also show him speaking and, at one moment, looking downward.
